ns2:section.sectionText: This is a fast-paced, online course taught in the Moodle course management system with no face to face classroom sessions. Although there are no scheduled meeting times, there are weekly assignment and project due dates. All assessments will be conducted online. Weekly, one-hour exams will be administered online between 2 and 6 PM Fridays. The last exam will be administered online 8 AM - noon, 1 August.
